payload.text: ISSUE:0304 (cc, after WP02b unless it bites sooner, vc 2026-10-31, medium): a dry run runs cut_run with errexit on (bin/devbin's set -euo pipefail) and a real cut with it off (run_gate's set +e, lib/runlog:2160), so an unchecked failing step stops a dry run and is passed over by the cut that publishes; fix: one state, the real cut's, and every command whose failure must stop the cut checks it through cut_fail; an arm reads a FAILED row in both modes.
